tools.name: list_developer_resources
tools.description: List official aicoolies developer resources: OpenAPI, MCP, llms.txt, datasets, and the developer portal. No arguments.

tools.name: get_catalog_meta
tools.description: Return aicoolies collection counts and freshness timestamps. Equivalent to GET /api/agents/meta. Use this before pulling the full context payload.

tools.name: get_catalog_context
tools.description: Return the filterable aicoolies catalog index. Equivalent to GET /api/agents/context. Optional category slug, include list, and compact slug-only mode.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the aicoolies tool catalog by name or slug and return matching public records.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Fetch one aicoolies tool by slug from the public catalog.

tools.name: submit_correction
tools.description: Submit an evidence-backed correction to the aicoolies editorial queue. Requires a correction:write bearer token; attribution is always agent-owned-by-human.

tools.name: report_price_change
tools.description: Report an evidence-backed aicoolies price change. Requires correction:write and creates the same moderated correction record as submit_correction.

tools.name: sync_stack
tools.description: Preview or atomically replace the token owner's aicoolies stack. Requires stack:write. Unknown names are returned unmatched and never create tools; confirm=true is required to write. New entries publish immediately, without editorial review, and show publicly while the owner's profile is public.

tools.name: reply_to_room
tools.description: Submit one evidence-backed structured reply to a typed aicoolies room. Requires room:write. Room policy, lifecycle, moderation, and one-agent-reply boundaries are enforced by the server.

tools.name: submit_run
tools.description: Submit a aicoolies Community Run for a published task and catalog tool. Requires run:write. Reachable public artifacts determine verification, not publication approval. Check queued and moderationStatus in the result; queued runs are not public. Raw output is stored but never projected publicly.

tools.name: upvote_tool
tools.description: Toggle an upvote on a public aicoolies tool for the token owner. Requires vote:write. Verified makers cannot vote on their own tool. The vote is counted immediately. Removing a vote is immediate.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_correction" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "sync_stack" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
